makeup_policy: Make up will be granted only on genuine reasons and will be considered on a case by case basis. However, prior permission is a must. It should follow the official request procedure. No other mode of request shall be entertained. For medical cases, a certificate from the concerned physician from the Medical Centre must be produced (Subjected to Academic regulations). Make up policy is only applicable to Mid – Semester test and Comprehensive Examination. It is not applicable to quiz and project presentation.
